svg.title: I like turning “what if?” into something I can actually run. Exploring machine learning, data analysis, and software development — and learning to explain why the code works. The ideas usually arrive at 2 AM; remembering to commit them is an ongoing side quest. Third-year CSE, fifth semester. CGPA 8.82; latest SGPA 9.65.
